subprocess_flow.description: Securely ingest candidate training, validation, and evaluation datasets into the MoJ isolated staging environment. Execute automated schema validation against cached data schema baselines to ensure mandatory structural conformance, data typing, and field definitions before resource-intensive profiling begins.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
success_criteria: 100% of candidate datasets ingested without truncation or corruption
Automated schema validation successfully confirms structure against baselines
subprocess_flow.purpose: Verify structural syntax and schema conformity at the point of ingestion to prevent corrupted data from entering profiling pipelines.
subprocess_flow.scope: All raw data files, tables, and streams provided for the registered AI model.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Receipt of approved Inception Registration and dataset provisioning
end_conditions: Validated schema match confirmation recorded in staging manifest

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Ingestion of corrupted, unexpected, or malformed data records causing pipeline failure
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated pre-validation against cached schema baselines with strict rejection triggers

change_management.change_request_process: Schema alteration notices must be submitted to Data Governance and approved by IAO
change_management.versioning_rules: Incoming raw data bundles fingerprinted using SHA-256 and registered in GitOps/DVC

subprocess_flow.description: Conduct end-to-end verification of dataset provenance, examining originating data store logs, custody transfers, and legal consent or statutory collection authorisations. Map all upstream transformations, joins, and filters to produce an immutable data lineage graph within the MoJ Centralised Data Catalog.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
outputs: Immutable Data Lineage Record in Data Catalog
success_criteria: Full lineage mapped back to authentic statutory MoJ data sources
Zero unclassified or unauthorized data elements identified in provenance chains
Immutable record successfully committed to Data Catalog
subprocess_flow.purpose: Establish verifiable and auditable chains of custody and statutory authority for all ingested justice sector data.
subprocess_flow.scope: All primary and secondary data sources linked to the AI training and testing pipelines.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Successful completion and approval of Cached Schema Validation Report
end_conditions: Formal publication of Data Lineage Record in the central catalog

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Ingestion of records lacking legal basis, statutory consent, or unverified custody trails
step_risks_and_controls.control: Mandatory provenance chain cryptographic check and IAO asset verification gate

change_management.change_request_process: Any alteration to data source locations or pipelines requires formal change request to Data Governance
change_management.versioning_rules: Lineage graph snapshot versioned semantically in Centralised Data Catalog

subprocess_flow.description: Deploy parallelised profiling pipelines to evaluate datasets against the core MoJ Data Quality Dimensions: completeness, accuracy, timeliness, validity, uniqueness, and consistency. Implement cached pre-validation modules to process large justice datasets concurrently without compute queueing backlogs.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
success_criteria: >= 99.5% data profiling accuracy achieved across all dimensions
Parallelised pipeline execution completed with zero queueing backlog
Automated metrics match or exceed baseline throughput goals
subprocess_flow.purpose: Detect anomalies, distribution skews, null density, and semantic invalidity rapidly across high-volume judicial data.
subprocess_flow.scope: Training, validation, and benchmarking datasets assigned to the AI model.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Validation of schemas and staging manifest availability
end_conditions: Generation of complete profiling metrics and automated execution reports

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Profiling infrastructure bottlenecking or time-outs on complex multi-million row court databases
step_risks_and_controls.control: Parallelised execution across distributed clusters with cached intermediate state storage

change_management.change_request_process: Data profiling parameter alterations require approval by the Lead Data Engineer
change_management.versioning_rules: Profiling rule suites maintained and tagged in GitOps repository

improvement_inputs: Data quality test suite failure rates

subprocess_flow.description: Evaluate profiling exceptions against MoJ quality thresholds. Execute automated and deterministic data cleansing workflows to remediate missing values, remove duplicates, normalize formats, and isolate unresolvable records into a quarantine container, generating an audit log of all modifications.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
success_criteria: All cleansing operations logged deterministically with reversible transformations
Corrupted or invalid records fully quarantined and documented
Data Cleansing & Validation Manifest successfully created
subprocess_flow.purpose: Normalize and remediate data hygiene issues while ensuring complete auditability and zero silent data mutation.
subprocess_flow.scope: All non-conforming records detected during automated profiling.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Receipt of automated profiling report flagging anomalies or formatting violations
end_conditions: Cleaned dataset staged and manifest signed by Data Steward

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Cleansing transformations distort underlying ground truth justice distributions
step_risks_and_controls.control: Deterministic rules with pre- and post-cleansing statistical distribution validation

change_management.change_request_process: Remediation rule modifications require Data Governance Board approval
change_management.versioning_rules: Cleaned datasets versioned with immutable hash snapshots via DVC

subprocess_flow.description: Synthesize automated profiling metrics, lineage records, and cleansing manifests into the official MoJ Data Quality Scorecard. Validate aggregate score against the mandatory 95% threshold; upon passing, secure formal CDO approval to authorize release to downstream AI pipelines.
subprocess_flow.responsible_party: Chief Data Officer / Head of Data Governance
outputs: MoJ Data Quality Scorecard (Completeness, Accuracy, Timeliness, Validity)
Parallelised Profiling and Automated Schema Validation Report
success_criteria: Data Quality Scorecard reflects an aggregate compliance score >= 95%
Formal CDO digital sign-off and approval achieved
Certificate of provenance and quality linked to the Registered AI Use Case Record
subprocess_flow.purpose: Provide final executive gating and certification that data assets meet justice quality standards prior to model ingestion.
subprocess_flow.scope: Finalized dataset release package for model training and evaluation.
subprocess_flow.process_owner: MoJ Chief Enterprise Architect & Head of Data Governance
triggers: Delivery of completed cleansing manifest and lineage map
end_conditions: Data Quality Scorecard meeting minimum thresholds and formal CDO approval

step_risks_and_controls.risk: Ingestion of corrupted, incomplete, or unverified justice records into operational models
step_risks_and_controls.control: Automated validation gate stopping data pipeline execution if composite quality score is below 95%

change_management.change_request_process: Scorecard threshold waivers require formal Senior Information Risk Owner (SIRO) exception authorization
change_management.versioning_rules: Scorecard artifact archived with immutable audit ID in Central Data Catalog

improvement_inputs: Downstream model retraining incidence due to data errors
